title: Quiet Heart, He Is Near
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sometimes the day is loud and fast,
Too busy, big, and wild,
A gentle song says, 'Now be still,
And know I'm here, my child.'

[Chorus]
Be still, be still, and know that God
Is right here by your side,
So take a breath and feel His peace,
Your safe place, warm and wide.

[Verse 2]
Slow down your body, slow your feet,
Make your heart quiet, too,
And when you're still you'll feel Him close,
A warm hug wrapping you.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the day is done,
The world is still and deep,
Heavenly Father's right beside,
So breathe and fall asleep.

[Chorus]
mood: Breathing music. Barely a pulse at all, just a slow rise and fall like a chest breathing in and out, so the song itself teaches the stillness the story is about. The sway is wide and calm, never pushing forward, with long quiet spaces between phrases. By the last verse it slows further and sinks lower, almost to a whisper of sound, until the room is quiet.
